rationale: Biggest steady speak_and_act miss in the baseline and round-1 traces: S18 and S25 (6 of 36 scored turns, every repeat in both runs). The caller states an in-range amount, then answers 'yes that's correct' / 'correct' to the combined STEP5 question. The agent asks 'And you handle these bills yourself?' again instead of transferring, because the prompt line 'Confirming only the unsecured half does not count' makes it read a yes to a question ending in '...no collateral attached, right?' as unsecured only. The edit says a plain yes to the combined question confirms both halves, so with an in-range amount the agent goes straight to STEP6. Single-half answers ('I'm the only one', 'just credit cards') and bare acknowledgements ('okay') still confirm that half alone, which keeps S20 and S17 (labelled not-yet-transfer) unchanged. Predicted: speak_and_act +0.06 to +0.17 (transfer bucket), action_correct up as well, premature transfers flat. About +90 prompt tokens (<1%), so first-action p50 stays near 630ms. Closings (S01/S14/S34) are left alone because round 1's closing table did not fix them and broke S06/S26.
